quotes.text: (Willie) just said, 'Al, be sure you sing you,' They gonna try and play it hip-hop, or this way or that, but you just be you.' That was good advice. But I think he forgot that once you start wrapping any song around Al, it's gonna sound just like 1974, '75, '76, '77, '78.
It's always different with different folks. You don't know what's gonna happen. And that creates an energy.
All the players are looking at Al, and seeing where he's turning so they can follow the turn. Sometimes the first way we did it turned out to be the best way we coulda done it.
